pages.title: A Bunch of Promise
pages.text: Start a vineyard with a small bunch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Vines need suitable supports. Look for ordinary vines in the world; regional varieties also come from a winemaker or their native regions.

pages.title: Establish a vineyard
pages.text: Ordinary and regional vines need suitable supports. Forest, savanna, taiga and jungle varieties provide different ingredients rather than a mandatory name checklist.
